test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 08 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The average runs of a cricket player of 10 innings were 40. How many runs must she make in her next inning so as to increase her average of runs by 3?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Required runs in the **next inning** = **Old Average** + (**Total Innings** × **Required Increase**)

Required runs = 40 + (11 × 3)

Required runs = 40 + 33 = 73

**∴ The correct answer is 73 runs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average of **10 innings** = 40 runs

Desired **increase** in average = 3 runs

**Formula Used:**

Total Runs = Average × Number of Innings

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/62f25413cd22081e79624348980b14775ae92fc29317427272bf55c360b0efbb.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total runs in first 10 innings = 10 × 40 = 400 runs

⇒ New average required = 40 + 3 = 43 runs

⇒ Total runs required for 11 innings = 11 × 43 = 473 runs

⇒ Runs to be scored in the 11th inning = Total (11 innings) − Total (10 innings)

⇒ Runs = 473 − 400 = 73 runs

**∴ The correct answer is 73 runs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Formula

Average = (Sum of all observations) ÷ (Total number of observations).

Average Increase Property

If the average of n terms increases by 'x' after adding a new term, the new term = Old Average + (n + 1) × x.

Average of Consecutive Numbers

For any arithmetic progression, Average = (First term + Last term) ÷ 2.</p
